main.description: Queue a job that brings the index rows of these catalogue games back in line with the catalogue PDS. The catalogue repo itself is not changed. Admins only. One reindex runs at a time.

uris.description: Catalogue game URIs. The job works through them 200 at a time.

dryRun.description: Compare only, and report how many would be reindexed.

perSecond.description: How many records to process per second, to go easy on the catalogue PDS.

count.description: How many URIs were queued; 0 when alreadyQueued is true.

alreadyQueued.description: True when a reindex was already pending or running; jobId is that job, and nothing new was queued.

status.description: The existing job's status, when alreadyQueued is true.
